cards.audioText: [You call sign is CES220, destination Pudong, over NIXAL 0025, level 12500m, estimate DOTOS 0035, next TODOM contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是CES220，目的地浦东。NIXAL上方0025，高度12500米，预计DOTOS 0035，下个报告点TODOM。联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES220, over NIXAL 0025, level 12500m, estimate DOTOS 0035, next TODOM.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，NIXAL上方0025，高度12500米，预计DOTOS 0035，下个报告点TODOM。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing Control, squawk 0077 radar contact, descend to and maintain 11900m.[Request 12500m to Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京区调，应答机0077雷达识别，下降保持11900米。【向北京区调请求高度12500米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES220, request to maintain 12500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，请求保持12500米。

cards.audioText: CES220, cleared to maintain 12500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，可以保持12500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to maintain 12500m. CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以保持12500米，东方220。

cards.audioText: [The plane encounters a strong head wind, and fuel is running out, the warning light is on, request alternate to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机遭遇强烈顶风，燃料正在耗尽，燃料示警灯亮了，请求备降北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CES220, request alternate to Beijing airport, we are running out of fuel due to head winds en route, our fuel light is on.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京区调，东方220，请求备降北京机场，由于巡航途中顶风燃料快耗尽，燃料警示灯亮着。

cards.audioText: CES220, roger, report endurance.[Report that your endurance is about 1 hour and 30 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，收到，报告续航时间。【报告你的续航时间约为1小时30分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Endurance 0130, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间0130，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, roger.[You cannot divert or hold in case of any emergency, so request direct to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，收到。【如果发生紧急情况你将无法备降或等待，所以请求直飞北京机场并优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES220, request direct to Beijing airport and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，请求直飞北京机场优先着陆。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, turn left heading 160, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，左转航向160，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 160, radar vector for landing, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向160，雷达引导着陆，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, descend to 8900m.[To save fuel, request maintain 12500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，下降8900米。【为节省燃油，请求保持12500米。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, request maintain 12500m to save fuel, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，请求12500米保持以节省燃油，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, maintain 12500m approved.[You are now approaching KM, 4500m maintaining, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information I, now contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，同意12500米保持。【你正在接近KM，4500米保持，KM01进场，跑道36左，通播I，现在联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES220, 4500m maintaining, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information I.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方220，4500米保持，KM01进场，跑道36左，通播I。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing Approach, descend to 2100m on QNH 1011, turn right heading 110 join downwind. Reduce speed to 250kts.[Readback]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京进近，下降到修正海压2100米，修正海压1011，右转航向110加入三边，减速250节。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2100m on QNH 1011, turn right heading 110 join downwind. Reduce speed to 250kts, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 降到修正海压2100米，修正海压1011，右转航向110加入三边，减速到250节，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, reduce speed to 190kts.[There is something wrong with the spoilers. They are locked in position, request maintain 210kts.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，减速到190节。【飞机扰流板出现问题，被锁在原位，请求保持210节。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES220, request maintain 210kts. Something is wrong with the spoilers. They are locked in position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方220，请求保持210节。飞机扰流板出现问题，被锁在原位。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, maintain 210kts. Report intention.[You intend to maintain 210kts, the minimum clean speed, and you are trying to extend the spoiler again.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，保持210节，报告意图。【你想保持最小光洁速度210节，并尝试再次打开扰流板。】
cards.referenceText: Request to minimum clean speed 210kts, and we are trying to extend the spoilers again, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求保持最小光洁速度210节，我们正在尝试再次打开扰流板，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, can you describe the problem further?[Tell the controller that you are sorting it out, probably hydraulic problem, or maybe steering system fault.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，你能进一步描述问题吗？【告诉管制员你正在检查，可能是液压问题，或是转向系统故障。】
cards.referenceText: We are sorting it out, suspect hydraulic problem, or steering system malfunctioned, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在检查，怀疑是液压问题，或转向系统故障，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, turn right heading 180, I will extend your downwind. Call me when you ready to turn in.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，右转航向180，我会延长你的三边，准备好转向五边通知。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, extended downwind, call you back, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，延长三边，稍后联系你，东方220。

cards.audioText: [2 minutes later.][You have solved the problem and can continue again.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【2分钟后】【你已经解决问题，现在可以继续进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES220, problem solved, request continue approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方220，问题已解决，请求继续进近。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, turn right heading 300 for base.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，右转航向300加入四边。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300 for base, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300加入四边，东方220。

cards.audioText: [Report to Beijing Tower that you have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【向北京塔台报告你已经建立盲降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES220, established on ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方220，已建立盲降。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker. [Over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京塔台，继续进近，到外信标台报告。【到达外信标台上方。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES220, outer marker、
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方220，到外信标台。

cards.audioText: CES220, cleared to land, wind 330, 8m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，可以着陆，地面风330, 8m/s，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, report vacated, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆，脱离后报告，东方220。

cards.audioText: [Request Beijing Tower to turn down the approach lights to grade 3, they look too bright from your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【向北京塔台请求将进场灯的亮度调为3级，从机内看进场灯太过明亮。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES220, request turn down the approach light to grade 3, they look too bright from here.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方220，请示调暗进场灯亮度到3级，在五边上看进近灯太亮。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, I will inform the ramp.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，我会通知机坪。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，东方220。
